Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_CHARS VARCHAR2(50) := 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
 V_NUMBERS VARCHAR2(50) := '0123456789';
 V_STR_TXT VARCHAR2(50);
 V_CURR_CHECK_STR VARCHAR2(50);
 V_BTRUE NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :System.TRIGGER_ITEM = :System.CURSOR_ITEM THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Value IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_STR_TXT := :System.Cursor_Value;
 V_BTRUE := 0;
 -- CHECK FIRST 4 CHARACTERS
 FOR I IN 1..4 LOOP
 IF INSTR(V_CHARS,SUBSTR(V_STR_TXT,I,1))= 0 THEN
 V_BTRUE := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- CHECK THE FIFTH CHARACTER IS SPACE
 IF SUBSTR(V_STR_TXT,5,1)<> ' ' THEN
 V_BTRUE := 1;
 END IF;
 -- CHECK THE REMAIN CHARACTER LENGTH MORE THAN 4 AND IS NUMBER
 V_CURR_CHECK_STR := SUBSTR(V_STR_TXT,6);
 IF LENGTH(V_CURR_CHECK_STR) >= 4 THEN
 FOR I IN 6..LENGTH(V_CURR_CHECK_STR) LOOP
 IF INSTR(V_NUMBERS,SUBSTR(V_STR_TXT,I,1))= 0 THEN
 V_BTRUE := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 V_BTRUE := 1;
 END IF;
 IF V_BTRUE = 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('رقم الحاوية غير صحيح','CFG_ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

-- Tries to move to previous canvas if previous canvas
-- belongs to the same window as the current canvas
DECLARE

 current_window VARCHAR2(80); 
 prev_block VARCHAR2(80); 
 next_item VARCHAR2(80);
 prev_canvas VARCHAR2(80);
 canvas_window VARCHAR2(80);
